title: Manager - AI Architect
description:
Role Purpose •     The Senior AI Architect will design and govern the AI solutions built on Voltas’ data platform, working hands-on with the Head – Data and AI and the partner AI team. The role owns the technical design of AI use cases, including insight engine intelligence, AI search over documents, machine learning and AI agents, and the shared platform services that make them reusable, secure and cost-efficient. It sets AI engineering standards and ensures every solution meets responsible AI and data privacy requirements. 1. AI Solution Architecture •     Design end-to-end architecture for AI use cases, including the insights engine, AI search over documents (RAG and GraphRAG), predictive models and AI agents. •     Translate business use cases into technical designs, estimates and build plans with the delivery team. •     Select models and patterns for each use case, balancing accuracy, speed, cost and risk. •     Review and approve designs and code from partner AI engineers. 2. AI Platform & Model Garden •     Design and run the shared AI platform: AI gateway, approved model catalogue, vector search, model serving and agent tooling on Azure and the data platform. •     Build reusable components: retrieval pipelines, prompt templates, evaluation harnesses and agent tools. •     Lead fine-tuning and hosting of open-source and small language models where needed, such as speech models for Indian languages. •     Contribute to the evaluation of data and AI platforms, including proofs of concept with vendors. 3. AI Engineering Standards & MLOps •     Define standards for AI development, testing, deployment and monitoring (MLOps and LLMOps). •     Set up evaluation: test sets, accuracy and groundedness checks, and regression testing before release. •     Monitor models in production for drift, quality and cost; drive retraining and improvement. 4. Governance, Security & Responsible AI •     Implement guardrails: personal data masking, prompt-injection protection, content safety and access control. •     Ensure AI solutions comply with the DPDP Act and Voltas security and governance policies. •     Track AI usage and cost by use case; enforce quotas and cost controls. •     Maintain architecture decision records and model documentation. 5. Technical Leadership & Capability Building •     Act as technical lead for AI engineers in the partner team: guide, review and unblock. •     Mentor internal data scientists and engineers; run knowledge-sharing sessions. •     Track emerging AI technologies and assess their fit for Voltas. What would Success look like •     Multiple phases of AI use cases built on approved architecture and running in production. •     A reusable AI platform (gateway, retrieval, evaluation) adopted by every new use case. •     AI solutions meeting agreed accuracy, speed and cost targets. •     No privacy or security incidents from AI solutions. •     Partner AI work consistently meeting Voltas quality standards. Key Deliverables / Success Metrics •     Number of AI use cases taken to production on the shared platform. •     Model accuracy and groundedness against agreed thresholds. •     AI cost per use case and per insight against budget. •     Time from approved design to pilot. •     Reuse of platform components across use cases. •     Compliance with AI governance and security standards.

Key Skills: C++,Embedded systems,Microsoft Windows,Microsoft Azure,Architecture,Embedded C,Machine,ISO
